entries.title: Al Noor: no analytics/AI/revenue-management work for any hospitality business in the GCC
entries.bound: AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd and all its Affiliates, including AtliQ Inc (12.1, 12.3)
entries.scope: Hospitality businesses headquartered in the GCC, or any work relating to properties in the GCC, wherever performed
quotes: the Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC.

services are provided "in the GCC" if the Hospitality Business receiving them is headquartered in, or the services relate to properties or operations located in, any state of the GCC, irrespective of where the services are performed.
"Restricted Period" means the Term and the period of eighteen (18) months following the expiry or termination of this Agreement.
entries.action: Ask Al Noor for a written waiver under clause 12.4 before signing, or take the GCC work out of scope. Send to counsel (Mehta Rao already has the Al Noor file).
entries.client_position: AtliQ is not able to provide analytics, AI or revenue-management work for hospitality properties in the GCC under this agreement. Please take the GCC properties out of scope, or let us discuss the scope on a call.

quotes: This consent is strictly limited to the Seaside SOW.
any other Hospitality Business, whether in the Sultanate of Oman or elsewhere in the GCC; or (c) any Affiliate of the Supplier.
entries.action: Shown alongside R-01: the existing waiver does not extend to any new hospitality client.

entries.title: Crestline: no other customer may get lower rates for similar services; lower rates apply to Crestline retroactively
entries.bound: AtliQ Inc and its Affiliates (incl. AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd)
entries.scope: Data engineering, BI and analytics resources; benchmark rates Senior Data Engineer $85, Data Engineer $62, BI Developer $58 per hour
quotes: Supplier represents and warrants that the rates, fees and other commercial terms offered to Crestline under this Agreement are and shall remain no less favorable than those offered by Supplier or its Affiliates to any other customer for substantially similar services during the Term.
such lower rates shall apply to Crestline retroactively from the date they were first offered to such other customer.
entries.action: Keep the new rate card at or above Crestline's rates, or price the retroactive Crestline credit into the deal before agreeing.
entries.client_position: We are not able to go below our standard rates for these roles. Please use the rates in our rate card.

entries.title: Northwind: IP in PipeKit, as incorporated in Northwind's deliverables, was assigned to Northwind
entries.scope: PipeKit (AtliQ's pipeline accelerator) and any pre-existing materials built into Northwind deliverables
quotes: All Intellectual Property Rights in the Deliverables, including any software, tools, frameworks, libraries and pre-existing materials incorporated into the Deliverables, shall vest in the Client absolutely upon payment of the Charges for the relevant Milestone.
PipeKit will be configured and extended for the Client and incorporated into the delivered pipeline as its ingestion and orchestration layer.
entries.action: Do not warrant sole ownership of PipeKit. Ask counsel whether the Northwind assignment covers the PipeKit core; check whether Northwind will license or re-assign it.
entries.client_position: AtliQ cannot warrant sole ownership of its PipeKit framework. Please limit the ownership warranty to the bespoke deliverables.

entries.bound: AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd and its Affiliates
entries.scope: Partner appointments with any cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or unified analytics platform, in India and the GCC
entries.until_note: Ends earlier if either side terminates on 90 days' notice (14.2)

entries.action: Limit the new partnership to territories outside India and the GCC (e.g. Europe), or end CloudSpan first on 90 days' notice.
